test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The mechanic will repair the bicycle on Sunday.

options.text: The bicycle will repaired by the mechanic on Sunday.
The bicycle will be repaired by the mechanic on Sunday.
The bicycle will be repairing by the mechanic on Sunday.
The bicycle would be repaired by the mechanic on Sunday.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The bicycle will be repaired by the mechanic on Sunday."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + will + V1 + object (Active Voice__)
 
• Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha will sing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Passive voice involves making the object of the active sentence the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The auxiliary verb** "will"** becomes **"will be" **in the passive voice.
 
• The past participle form of the main verb **"repair" is "repaired" **in the passive voice.
 
• The agent of the action** (in this case, the mechanic)** is introduced with the preposition **"by"** in the passive voice.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
